frmc.embeddium.options.chunk_fade_in.too:
Newly loaded chunks fade in out of the fog over 0.75 seconds instead of popping in. Costs nothing extra while no chunk is fading.

Has no effect when a shader pack is active.
frmc.embeddium.options.gui_animations.to: Animates hovering, tick boxes, sliders, tab switches and scrolling on this screen. Purely cosmetic.
frmc.embeddium.options.mesh_buffer_growt: Embeddium 0.3.31 multiplies by the vertex stride one time too many when a chunk mesh buffer grows, so dense chunk sections allocate far more native memory than they need. When enabled, buffers grow by what is actually required.
frmc.embeddium.options.block_entity_box_:
Caches the render bounding box of block entities that use the default Forge implementation, instead of recomputing it for every visible block entity every frame. Block entities with custom bounds and blocks with dynamic shapes are not affected.

Disable this if block entities disappear early at the edge of the screen.
frmc.embeddium.options.radix_vertex_sort: Immediate-mode layers such as translucent entities and particles are sorted with a radix sort instead of a merge sort once they reach 256 quads. The resulting order is the same. Chunk terrain is not affected.
frmc.embeddium.options.sprite_marking_pe:
Embeddium walks every visible chunk section each frame to mark its animated textures as active, but texture animations only advance 20 times per second. When enabled, the marking happens once per game tick instead, which saves more the higher your frame rate is.

Only applies while Animate Only Visible Textures is enabled. Disable this if animated textures in view stop moving.
While building chunk meshes, faces of the same block model that share a tint index query their color only once, which speeds up tinted blocks with many faces. Biome-blended grass, foliage and water, and color providers registered by other mods, are not affected.

If block colors look wrong, disable this and reload chunks.
frmc.embeddium.options.shadow_update_int:
With a shader pack active, the shadow map is only re-rendered every few frames; the frames in between reuse the previous shadows, shifted to follow the camera. Shadows are usually the most expensive part of a shader pack, so raising this can noticeably improve frame rate.

In exchange, shadows of moving mobs and of the sun update less often, more visibly so at higher values.

Shader packs that rely on features such as voxelized colored lighting always update every frame. Has no effect without a shader pack.
frmc.embeddium.options.chunk_upload_budg:
Limits how much finished chunk mesh data is uploaded to the GPU per frame; anything over the limit is uploaded on the following frames. This smooths frame time spikes when many chunk sections finish building at once, but those sections appear a few frames later.

Blocks you place or break are never delayed, and the limit is lifted automatically when too many sections are waiting.

If chunks load visibly slower, raise the value or turn it off.
